name: Snickers
ingredients_raw: Milk chocolate coating (38%) Sugar, Milk solids, Cocoa butter, Cocoa solids, Edible vegetable fats <5% (Sal fat, Palm oil), Dextrose, Emulsifier (322); Centre filling (62%): Liquid glucose, Peanuts (14%), Sugar, Fractionated vegetable fat, Milk solids, iodized salt, Cocoa butter, Cocoa solids, Edible vegetable fats <5% (Sal fat, Palm oil), Dextrose, Emulsifier (322). CONTAINS COCOA BUTTER EQUIVALENT IN ADDITION TO COCOA BUTTER. Contains Peanuts, Milk, Soy. May contain Treenuts.
